comparison.objective: Close double enclosure doors in the order imposed by an astragal, then bolt and latch them; candidate extracts a terminal.
comparison.physical_skill: Ordered large-body closure and sequential bolt/latch actuation versus fine single-blade access beneath a recessed tab and coordinated withdrawal.
comparison.success_condition: Both leaves closed in valid order and secured by bolt and latch; candidate requires one terminal removed without collateral release or damage. Candidate thresholds are missing.
comparison.reason: Latch operation alone is too generic to make these tasks overlap.
